0022600119.text: The Charlotte Hornets (2-1, second in the Southeast and 0.5 games back) host the Washington Wizards (1-1, third in the Southeast and one game back) in the Hornets' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with Charlotte on a one-game winning streak and fifth in the East, one spot ahead of Washington. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Hornets won the 2025-26 series 4-0, most recently beating Washington 129-112 in Washington on February 22, 2026. Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery), while Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve).
